title: Bird Furoshiki Series
description:
Inspired by birds that walk, swim, and climb, I focused on their distinctive features and expressions.

The magnificent crest of the Victoria crowned pigeon, the vibrant face of the rainbow lorikeet, and the large beak of the Atlantic puffin.

Using these birds’ unique facial features as motifs, I brought them to life through screen printing. The designs reflect the discoveries and sense of wonder I experienced while observing birds in nature, translating them onto fabric.
